languages.en: To my amazing sister: thank you for tying my childhood together with love. Sending you the biggest Rakhi hug!
languages.hi: मेरी शानदार बहन को: मेरे बचपन को प्यार से बाँधने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपको सबसे बड़ी राखी वाली झप्पी!
languages.hinglish: Meri amazing behen ko: thanks mere bachpan ko pyaar se baandhne ke liye. Sending you sabse badi Rakhi wali jhappi!

altText.en: Raksha Bandhan greeting card for sister: To my amazing sister: thank you for tying my childhood together with love. Sending you the biggest Rakhi hug!
